selection_rationale: CNSM2026-A1 (Generate→Validate→Repair with deterministic verifier) best aligns with the track’s focus on NetOps safety/reliability, has clear, falsifiable hypotheses and a paired experimental design, is experimentally tractable within the stated compute budget, and directly tests an operationally meaningful intervention (verifier-guided repair) with measurable outcomes (regression rate, blast radius).
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic verifier coverage for vendor-specific features and how unsupported features will be handled in analysis.
External validity: how results on the synthetic/Cornetto-like benchmark generalize to production multi-vendor deployments.
Prompt sensitivity and model-dependence: degree to which results depend on chosen LLM(s) and prompt templates.
Potential verifier false-positive and false-negative rates and their impact on measured mitigation effect.
Adequacy of the planned sample size (200 tasks) for detecting preregistered effect sizes across strata (topology scale, vendor mix).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Pre-register exact deterministic verifier (name, version) and enumerate supported/unsupported vendor features; specify handling policy for unsupported features (exclude, map to fallback, or annotate).
Include multiple LLM families and multiple prompt seeds; preregister prompt templates, temperature/settings, and random seeds to assess prompt/model sensitivity.

Precisely operationalize and preregister metric definitions: formal definitions and thresholds for "functional regression", "blast-radius" (e.g., impacted prefixes/nodes normalization), and any policy-violation counts.

Design and preregister procedures to measure verifier false-positives and false-negatives (e.g., oracle checks or manual adjudication on a stratified subset) and plan to report their influence on primary outcomes.
Provide and preregister a statistical power/sample-size calculation for the paired design; justify or adjust the 200-task target and preregister strata and alpha adjustments (multiple comparisons).
Preregister exact paired-analysis statistical tests, effect-size measures, bootstrap/CI procedures, and the handling of failed/unsupported tasks (exclusion rules and sensitivity analyses).

Specify repair-loop stopping rules (max iterations), iteration-level logging, timeout policies, and retry policies for infrastructure/model/API failures; preregister how retries will be treated in analyses.

Document sandbox/emulation environment details (Batfish or equivalent config), dataset generation procedure (topology/vendor mixes), and ensure all experiments run in isolated simulated environments (no live networks, no credentials).

Preregister prompt-sensitivity and robustness analyses (e.g., report per-model/per-prompt results and pooled estimates), and commit to publishing prompts and anonymized artifacts consistent with ethical constraints.

Predefine the exact blast-radius and regression aggregation procedures (per-change vs per-task), and preregister secondary analyses (topology-scale strata, vendor-mix strata) with multiple-comparison controls.
